## Prediction checks (LOG.md, 2026-11-15)

1. period: best of COL/ADD/LR at most 0.80 of P0 at 50: COL 0.259
2. all groups: best informative at most 0.85 of P0 at 50: ADD 0.725; by n&#772;: 50: 0.725, 100: 0.768, 200: 0.831, 400: 1.017
3. GRP within 5% of P0 at every n&#772;: 1.050, 1.054, 1.045, 1.003
4. robust coverage around ADD at least 94% at every n&#772;: 98.4%, 96.5%, 95.4%, 94.8%; large-bias groups at least 75% at 50: 93.3%
5. LR no better than ADD by more than 0.03 (ratio to P0 at 50): LR 0.818, ADD 0.725
Refutation (no informative prior at most 0.95 of P0 at 50): COL 0.766, ADD 0.725, LR 0.818
